column1: # Mario Kart World (Switch 2, loose dump of update 917504). Shader split only: no build has been packed or run from this profile, so it claims no
# version hashes and has no android.tsv.
# Nintendo EPD's engine (Nin_Ounce: sead / agl / gsys, Phive), NVN2 (Ampere shaders); modules main + sdk + subsdk0 + subsdk1.
# Shaders: Shader/*.Nin_Ounce_NVN2.bfsha.zs (BNSH), one .sarc.zs holding agl sharcb packs, and the effect set's esetb. See docs/SWITCH2.md.
# ---- Memory (provisional: address-space reservations; the heap figure is measured, the rest is not) ----
# A Switch 2 title plans its heap from a 12 GiB DRAM layout, and NVN2 keeps a second 8 GiB for the graphics server. These are host reservations, not
# values the game reports. The heap is the part that has to be right: Mario Kart World's first SetHeapSize asks for 0x1fe400000 (8.16 GB), and this
# host gives the heap whatever the reserve has left after the alias region and the stack, so 25 GB less 16 GB alias, 256 MB stack and a 256 MB gap
# leaves 8.5 GB. A 20 GB reserve left only 3.5 GB and the title's first 54 MB allocation came back as 0x1000.
